title: 第一卷 人生初见第二十五章 尘世第一卷 人生初见第二十六章 恶灵
slug: 尘世刀吟第四百八十章不简单
content_zh:
长孙看着手中的刀，越看越感觉爱不释手。
不得不说无名为他打造这把刀是花了功夫的，刀的重量、长度都经过了计算，对于长孙来说刚刚好。
而且刀锋的弧度也十分的有讲究，能够很大程度的减少出刀时耗费的无用功。
长孙随意的挥了几刀，感觉轻轻松松便切开周围的阻力，忍不住再次赞叹一句“好刀。”
“那是自然，想当年，有多少人求着我为其锻造灵器。
你小子算是捡了大便宜，哼。”
无名张口说道。
“前辈说得是，能够遇到前辈那是我命中最大的幸事，您不是大便宜，您是大贵人。”
长孙得了便宜卖乖。
“算你小子识相，对了，这把刀练得急，还未起名字，要不我帮你给这把刀起个名字”
无名问道。
长孙一听无名要起名字，赶忙说道：“不劳烦前辈了，我自己来就好了。”
无名起名的本事长孙是见识了，长孙实在是不敢恭维。
长孙看着刀，思考了片刻心里便有了主意：“刀便要有一往无前的气势，要有无坚不摧的锐气，斩有形，破无形。
我便起名为，破风。”
长孙起名为破风还有另一层意思是希望自己能够有朝一日破开封印，解救初黎。
破风，亦破封。
无名听了这个名字，想了片刻没有接话。
无名已经听出了长孙的初心。
“你的路很难，这把刀是你的武器也是你得伙伴，它将陪伴你看过尘世种种，历经磨难万千……我更希望你能在这尘世中历练，突破这尘世的束缚，找到真正的自我。”

无名在默默开口。
“好了，别墨迹了，继续修炼。”
无名沉默了片刻后，开口说道。
长孙收回注视破风的目光，看着无名，目光深沉，恭敬的说道：“请前辈指点，是晚辈急功近利了，此刀尘世，带我勘破尘世之日，才是破风之时。”
长孙将刀更名为“尘世”
“嗯，接下来你便用尘世修炼，方法很简单，都在石门上了，你自己去看，照着石门的印记出刀就行了。”
无名对于长孙的态度很满意。
长孙走到石门前，石门上不再像前段时间修炼时那样凹凸不平，变得平整了许多，只是墙面上会不断的出现一些印记，就如同迷宫的线一般，让长孙摸不到头绪。
长孙这阶段的修炼就是用刀临摹，但要求精度十分高，这又是一个看似简单实则很难的修炼。
长孙看了一阵，忽然转过头去问道：“前辈，那这次出错的处罚是什么”
“嗯……这次没有处罚。”
content_en:
Changsun looked at the knife in his hand, and the more he looked at it, the more he couldn't put it down.
I have to say that Wuwei spent a lot of effort to build this knife for him. The weight and length of the knife were all calculated, and it was just right for the eldest grandson.
Moreover, the curvature of the blade is also very particular, which can greatly reduce the wasted effort when drawing the knife.
Changsun swung the knife a few times casually, feeling that it could easily cut through the resistance around him. He couldn't help but praise again, "Good knife."
"That's natural. Think about how many people begged me to forge spiritual weapons for them back then.
You kid got a big deal, huh. "
Wuming opened his mouth and said.
"Senior is right. Meeting senior is the greatest blessing in my life. You are not a cheap person, you are a noble person."
The eldest grandson gets an advantage and behaves well.
"You're a smart kid. By the way, I've been practicing this sword in a hurry and haven't given it a name yet. How about I help you give this sword a name?"
Wuming asked.
When the eldest grandson heard that Wuming wanted to give a name, he quickly said: "Senior, don't bother me anymore, I can do it myself."
The eldest grandson has seen Wuming's ability to name names, but the eldest grandson really doesn't dare to compliment him.
Changsun looked at the sword, thought for a moment and then came up with an idea: "The sword must have an indomitable momentum and an indestructible spirit, capable of cutting the visible and breaking the invisible.
I named it Po Feng. "
The eldest grandson named Po Feng also means that he hopes that one day he can break the seal and rescue Chu Li.
Breaking the wind also breaks the seal.
After Wuming heard the name, he thought for a moment but didn't answer.
Wuming had already heard Changsun's original intention.
"Your road is difficult. This knife is your weapon and your partner. It will accompany you through all kinds of things in the world and go through countless hardships... I hope you can experience in this world, break through the shackles of this world, and find your true self."
Wuming spoke silently.
"Okay, stop inking and continue practicing."
After Wuming was silent for a moment, he spoke.
The eldest grandson withdrew his gaze from Po Feng, looked at Wuming with a deep gaze, and said respectfully: "Senior, please give me some advice. This junior is eager for quick success. The day when this sword will lead me to break through the world is Po Feng's time."
The eldest grandson renamed the sword "Chenshi"
"Well, then you can practice in this world. The method is very simple. It's all on the stone gate. You can see it yourself and follow the mark on the stone gate to draw the sword."
Wuming was very satisfied with his eldest grandson's attitude.
Changsun walked to the stone door. The stone door was no longer as uneven as it was when he practiced some time ago, and became much smoother. However, some marks would continue to appear on the wall, just like the lines of a maze, making Changsun confused.
Changsun's practice at this stage involves copying with a knife, but it requires very high precision. This is another practice that seems simple but is actually very difficult.
The eldest grandson looked at it for a while, then suddenly turned around and asked: "Senior, what is the punishment for making this mistake?"
"Well...there is no punishment this time."
